other_failure_modes.name: Unregularized Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding statistics (mean, median, etc.) directly on the entire training fold without employing additive smoothing or inner cross-validation. This makes the model highly susceptible to overfitting on categorical combinations with very few sample points.

summary: The agent successfully engineers many domain-appropriate features and correctly optimizes the custom WMAE metric using sample weights. However, a critical failure occurs because the agent ignores the temporal nature of the dataset, utilizing a randomly shuffled K-Fold cross-validation instead of a time-based split. Furthermore, the target encodings are computed without any form of regularization, which can lead to severe overfitting.
